dogecoin.text: We wanted to understand how Elon Musk's acquisition of Twitter might ultimately benefit users of the popular social media app.  So we talked to three Dogecoin enthusiasts at a Sweetgreen in Palo Alto.

In this Ohio diner, it was a tradition: dial into AOL, do a keyword search for Dogecoin, then everyone gathers around the monitor to see just how much their little nest egg has gone up in value.  But after yesterday, that tradition is no more.
In this North Carolina town, Elon still means the local university. But they do know this: It would be a genius disruptor move to change the national currency from the dollar to Dogecoin.
